name: aptora
description: Manage your CVs, discover relevant job opportunities, and keep your professional profile up to date with Aptora. Create and update CVs directly from ChatGPT, match your experience and skills with jobs, and prepare tailored CV versions for specific opportunities — while keeping your profile and career data in one place.
